{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Mysterious Sphere
| Image = Event-Sphere.png
}}
{{E|Mysterious Sphere}} is an [[Event]] found exclusively in [[Act 3]].

== Options ==
{{Frame|Open Sphere}} {{TS|negative||Fight.}} {{TS|positive||Reward: }} {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Rare|Rare}} {{TS|positive||[[Relic]].}}
* The player enters combat with the 2 {{M|Orb Walker|Orb Walkers}}. In addition to the {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Rare|Rare}} [[Relic]], the combat rewards also yield 45-55 [[Gold]], a normal card reward, and potentially a [[Potion]] just like a normal combat.
<br>
{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
Jutting from the chaotic terrain around you, a bony sphere surrounds a mysterious glowing object within.<br>
While you are curious what lies inside, you notice some sentries keeping an eye on it.
</div>

{{Frame|Open Sphere}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
As soon as you strike the sphere, the sentries spring to life around you!
</div>
<br><br>
{{Frame|Fight}}
<br><br>
The sphere visually breaks open and the player enters combat with the 2 {{M|Orb Walker|Orb Walkers}}.
</blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
No need to be greedy.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Notes ==
* Although the fight can be quite dangerous and offers a [[Relic]] reward, it does not count as an [[Elite]] combat for the sake of {{R|Preserved Insect}}, {{R|Sling of Courage}}, {{R|Black Star}}, and {{R|Slaver's Collar}}.

== Update History ==
* '''Weekly Patch 46: Adrenaline'''
** The Mysterious Sphere event in Act 3 now uses the Double Orb Walker combat. (was Orb Walker and 2 Shapes)
* '''Weekly Patch 31: Custom Mode'''
** Clarified relic rarity on Mysterious Sphere event.
* '''Weekly Patch 25: Building Blocks'''
** Mysterious Sphere event enemies now attack in the correct order
* '''Weekly Patch 8: Ooh Shiny!'''
** Minor wording improvements for the Mysterious Sphere event.
